topics.title: Howard's Lobby Complaint
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Howard expresses frustration about the state of his office lobby and suggests Gary clean it. He engages in playful arguments with co-hosts regarding maintaining a tidy workspace while also initiating trivia questions to distract from the issue.

topics.title: Howard Stern Trivia, Acura Awards & Scott Munney Confrontation
topics.summary: The broadcast features a trivia game with Howard Stern and guests, including questions about obscure facts like Jackie the Joke Man’s Star Trek appearance. A segment details how Acura Bedford Hills received the National Precision Award for exceptional customer service – picking up customers at train stations and ensuring post-sale happiness – culminating in an awkward encounter between Scott Munney and Robin Quivers involving accusations and shouting.

topics.title: Caller Breakdown, Jackie the Joke Man & Dee Snider
topics.summary: A distressed caller recounts a breakup and bizarre water conservation suggestions involving fat people in bathtubs before transitioning to an interview with comedian Jackie the Joke Man who discusses his London concert experience including an altercation where Twisted Sister’s Dee Snider flew off stage. The program concludes with trivia questions and scoring.

topics.title: Snapple Trivia & Footlicker Conversations
topics.summary: During a Howard Stern show segment, hosts engage in rapid-fire Snapple trivia questions about flavors and Keith’s girlfriend while Darren ‘the footlicker’, Alison, and Fred discuss potential mail order brides. The conversation repeatedly uses the word 'man,' particularly during an extended discussion involving Keith.”}çát cháo 104 times.

topics.title: Radio Confessional Breakdown
topics.summary: Two individuals engage in a bizarre and escalating argument filled with illogical tangents about counting people, imaginary pills, and references to Howard Stern’s mother while exploring themes of inhibitions and unwanted attention. The conversation devolves into absurd speculation regarding the cleanliness of a lobby and an apparent obsession with taking off clothing.

topics.title: Explicit Nose Rubbing & Sexual Requests
topics.summary: During a lengthy segment, two individuals engage in explicit requests involving rubbing one person’s nose while discussing sexual fantasies and desires with detailed descriptions of physical reactions and intentions to heighten arousal.
